C0594.title: First Case: Streamer Jailed for Leaking Honor of Kings Skins for Profit
C0594.summary: A report on August 2, 2024 said a court had recently delivered a first-instance judgment in a copyright infringement case. The defendant Liu, a video blogger, repeatedly published unreleased Honor of Kings game content to obtain advertising revenue and amplified the spread through account traffic. The court found the conduct constituted copyright infringement and sentenced Liu to three years in prison with a five-year suspended sentence and a 300,000 yuan fine. The case reflects copyright infringement risks and platform governance pressure when unreleased game content leakage is combined with traffic monetization.
